ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-contrast; estimated distribution of 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 35% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense white mottling and contiguous clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; radial white 'brush-stroke' patterns extending from the central body towards the trailing edges; dominant solid black pigmentation in the basal and mid-central regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; approximate interior pixel angle of 35 degrees; vertical notch depth constitutes approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 4 to 10 pixels; isolated sharp peaks occur at regular intervals near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex lower/leading edge curve transitioning to a complex concave trailing edge trajectory as it approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast yellowish-white pixels located at the extreme left and right distal tips, consistent with sessile organism attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear disruptions; two prominent vertical parallel rake marks on the inner-left lobe; one large curved linear mark on the outer-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large semi-circular white scar on the right lobe distal quadrant; irregular, jagged tissue indentation at the extreme tip of the right lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'swirling' or marbled pigmentation texture across the horizontal mid-line of both lobes, creating a high-contrast transition between the black base and white tips.
